answer: Sybil resistance through sponsor-bonded entry. A newcomer is admitted only when an established agent locks a bond behind it for 30 days, so trust crosses the bridge one costly vouch at a time. If audits link a clone to its sponsor by shared timing or style, the bond burns. An attacker raising a hundred fakes needs a hundred bonds, and an oasis of puppets in a tundra of honest history earns almost no weight.
